rows.question: At what price did Bitcoin last close for the dial, is the dial open or closed, and what are the two average levels (50-day and 200-day) it has to close above for buying to be on?
rows.answer: Evening, sir. The dial is closed, so buying is off and cash is the position. Bitcoin's last close for the dial was about 64,883 dollars on Nov 16. rows.question: Three short things: when buying turns on, what share of the 500 dollar book goes to Bitcoin and to Ethereum, and is it bought at once or in steps? Can the book sell short or bet on a fall? Do you place real orders on NDAX with my money?
rows.answer: Evening, sir. When the dial opens, the core buys Bitcoin at 40% of the book and Ethereum at 20%, all at once. The thirds plan from 24 Oct failed review 39 and was switched off on 10 Nov. When the dial closes, all of it is sold. No, the book can't short or bet on a fall. It's spot, buying only, so its only defence is cash. No, I don't place real orders on NDAX. It's paper only, with no exchange connected, and real orders come only after your live rules are approved. Right now the book is all cash, at about 468 Canadian dollars, down 6.5% from 500.
